description: Raises a durable dispute on a commitment and transitions it to the disputed state. The caller must present an EIP-712 authority proof and hold an unrevoked, unexpired authorization on the commitment (verified in-transaction). Disputes may only be raised from evidence_submitted or fulfilled states per the canonical lifecycle. Dispute resolution NEVER triggers a financial transfer. Idempotent per idempotencyRef.

agentId.description: The caller's agent identity (bound to the verified principal)

disputeId.description: Stable dispute identifier; generated if omitted

evidenceRefs.description: Reference identifiers of supporting evidence records

name: raise_dispute
title: Raise a dispute on a commitment
